releaseNotesBody:
SinKey v1.0.35 — Reliable Windows 10/11 speech detection

- Stops normal microphone noise from being treated as continuous speech after the VAD threshold relaxes below the Windows endpoint noise floor.
- Excludes startup calibration audio from the first Sinhala recognition request and keeps only a short pre-roll while idle.
- Rejects one-frame USB/Bluetooth audio spikes while preserving fast speech onset detection.
- Adds regression coverage for quiet microphones, normal endpoint noise, and transient capture spikes.

SinKey v1.0.34 — Windows 11 microphone reconnect

- Keeps voice typing active through transient Windows 11 USB, Bluetooth, and shared audio endpoint resets by re-enumerating and reopening microphone routes instead of ending the helper.
- Retries an unexpected helper exit up to three times with a short delay instead of immediately turning the tray microphone off.
- Adds safe diagnostics for helper/PortAudio errors without logging microphone audio or recognized text.

SinKey v1.0.33 — Resilient Sinhala recognition transport

- Uses the official PyPI `SpeechRecognition` library directly as the fast primary path.
- Retries a no-result or temporary direct-provider failure once through the MyFonts server-side SpeechRecognition route using the same complete microphone recording.
- Adds privacy-safe provider-stage telemetry; no microphone audio or recognized text is recorded in logs.

SinKey v1.0.32 — Direct SpeechRecognition voice path

- Sinhala desktop voice typing now uses the official PyPI `SpeechRecognition` library directly instead of routing microphone recordings through the MyFonts website API first.
- Removes the unnecessary server hop and makes microphone/recognition failures easier to diagnose.
- Adds privacy-safe recognition transport stage logging; recognized text and microphone audio are never logged.

SinKey v1.0.31 — Auto-update version verification repair

- Fixes release packaging so the installed `SinKey.exe` carries the same version as the update feed and installer.
- Resolves the loop where an update could install but SinKey continued to report that same update as available.
- Includes the v1.0.30 MyFonts dictation timing repair.

SinKey v1.0.30 — Reliable MyFonts dictation commits

- Fixes a desktop-helper timing error that could stop a completed MyFonts speech recording before its result was returned.
- This is especially important for Windows 11 microphone sessions: the microphone could show as active while no text was committed.
- Keeps the 16 kHz WAV → MyFonts.lk `/api/speech` provider and direct Google fallback unchanged.

SinKey v1.0.29 — MyFonts Speech Provider

- Uses the same 16 kHz WAV → MyFonts.lk `/api/speech` recognition flow as the website.
- Sends short complete recordings without allowing desktop VAD to discard valid speech first.
- Falls back to direct Google recognition only if the MyFonts service is temporarily unavailable.
- Retains Windows microphone routing, Unicode/Legacy typing, and privacy-safe stage logging.
